author: tasokop941
quote: I sold my copy almost immediately. After just five hours of gameplay, I completely lost interest. It barely brings anything new compared to the original, aside from the graphical improvements. That said, it could be a great experience for those who never played the N64 version, and it might make a lovely Christmas gift for a child under 12. It's just not what I was hoping for as someone familiar with the original.
